speaker: narrator
text: Under the last parish the walls are hollow. Doors open in the stone where no doors were, and shut again behind you.

speaker: emeric
text: Gerhardt wrote about them. Older than the Count, he said. They'll sell to anyone. Page nine. He bought.

speaker: narrator
text: Out of the wall steps the eldest of the coven, bent double, with his violets braided into her grey hair.

speaker: eldest-witch
text: We were here first. He only promised we'd be here last.

speaker: narrator
text: The eldest falls, and the coven is broken. The doors in the stone are only doors now.

speaker: narrator
text: You climb back into the grey daylight. Up on the hill, he is a little more alone.
